Perfect! All 55 tests pass. I've created the render module:

**Created src/render.js** with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` that:
- Shows invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued) on the first line
- Shows customer name on the second line
- Shows one line per invoice item with: qty, name, unit price, line total
- Shows total on the last line
- All amounts formatted via formatEuros() with EUR symbols and proper decimals

**Format example:**
```
INV-2026-0001
Kite & Co
5x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
3x Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €285.00
Total: €710.00
```

**Created comprehensive tests** covering draft/issued invoices, multiple lines, various amount formats (decimals, thousands separators), and proper line structure.
